channel.description: Latest articles from The Free Press (usmfreepress.org)

item.title: Eating at USM with Severe Food Allergies
item.description: A student with life-threatening food allergies reflects on the ongoing challenges of navigating Brooks Dining Hall, arguing that meaningful institutional changes remain absent.

item.title: Uncomplicating cars
item.description: Uncomplicating cars is back to explain what to do if you get a flat tire, and how to change one.

item.title: USM National Survey of Student Engagement
item.description: The University of Southern Maine encourages students to fill out the National Survey of Student Engagement.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Overcomes Adversity
item.description: Lindsey Vonn tackles an athlete's worst nightmare as she tries to battle through one injury to compete in the Winter Olympics, but instead has to battle the idea that her poor judgment to compete still almost cost her a leg.

item.title: Book Review
item.description: The Inmate is a psychological thriller that captivates the mind while reading, and is a book you just cannot wait to read.

item.title: Scream 7 Movie Review
item.description: The Scream franchise returns to theaters for a seventh installment, and while it was a fun time, Scream 7 feels more like a Stab movie than a Scream movie.

item.title: Paramount Set to Acquire Warner Bros. Discovery After Netflix Backs Out of Bidding War
item.description: After months of whirlwind drama back and forth, Paramount Skydance now appears to be coming out on top amid the bidding war for Warner Bros. Discovery. Netflix has declined to raise their offer, thus leaving Paramount poised to acquire WBD. CEO David Ellison has revealed some of his plans for the merged company.

item.title: Beast Games Season 2 Finale: High Stakes, Big Drama
item.description: Airing on Amazon Prime, season 2 of YouTuber MrBeast’s game show, Beast Games, comes to an end. The top six quickly dwindles down, and one contestant walks away with the $5,000,000 grand prize.

item.title: Good News Roundup
item.description: From cancer prevention to climate change to chair volleyball, this installment of “Good News Roundup” discusses what is actually going right in the world.

item.title: A Killer LECS Weekend for the Huskies All Over New England
item.description: An in-depth discussion of the strong performances during NCAA Division III New England Championship and Little East Conference Championship.
